sheet-columns-by-header.title: Read and write Sheet columns by header name, add new columns automatically, and stop writes from losing data
sheet-columns-by-header.why: About ten later items add Sheet columns. Reads are positional, so a new column, or a volunteer inserting one by hand, shifts the hidden JSON column and wipes plans. The writes also clear whole tabs before rewriting them, and they silently truncate JSON at 45k characters.
sheet-columns-by-header.spec:
STORAGE LAYER (apps-script/src/Code.js):
- Add cols_(name). It reads row 1 (1..getLastColumn) and maps header text to a 1-based column, matching case-insensitively and ignoring surrounding spaces.
- rows_(name, keepBlank) returns each row in CANONICAL TABS order: for each TABS[name] header, take the value from its actual column, or '' if the column is missing. Existing positional callers (r[0], r[4] …) keep working unchanged.
- write_, append_ and saveEvent_'s in-place row update write each canonical column into its actual column.
- ensure_() checks existing tabs too. Any TABS header missing from row 1 is appended after the last used header (bold, background #E8F0DF), and the '@' text format is applied to that column. Existing columns are never reordered.
- Rule for every later item: new columns are always appended to the END of the TABS arrays.
- The Events JSON column is found by its header "data (don't edit)", so a hand-inserted column no longer corrupts plans.

SAFER WRITES:
- replaceFor_ and write_ write the new table first, then clear only the leftover rows below it. No more clear-then-write of the whole tab.
- Before writing past the sheet's getMaxRows(), call insertRowsAfter.
- Apply the '@' format to every newly written range.
- Keep only the newest 100 Activity rows per event.

SIZE: when JSON.stringify(p.data) is over 45000 characters, saveEvent_ throws "This event's plan is too long to save. Shorten the notes." and the row is left untouched. cell_ keeps capping other cells.

HAND-EDIT PARSING:
- normDate_ also accepts 'Oct 31, 2026', 'October 31, 2026', '2026/10/31', and '10/31' (taken as the current year). Use a small month-name table, not new Date(string).
- normTime_ also accepts 'noon', '10am', '10:30 a.m.'.
- Events rows whose id is set but whose date still doesn't parse are no longer silently dropped. signIn returns problems: [{tab:'Events', row:N, what:"date 'xyz' not understood"}].
- The Events page shows each problem as a dismissible note: 'Fix in the Sheet: Events row 7, date "xyz" not understood.'
- Client: a tag that isn't in TAGS renders as its own text (never 'undefined') in tagLabels, the docHTML tags and the flyers.

MOCK (apps-script/test/gas-mock.js): add getLastColumn, getMaxRows (default 1000) and insertRowsAfter to Sheet.

server-side-posting.why: Post races the save. A new event fails with 'Save the event first' (reproduced on the mock), an edited event posts the old time, and the browser only records 'posted' later, so a lost save can send the Google Group email twice. It replies window.postMessage({source:'ebpg-poster', type:'opened', channel}, origin) or {source:'ebpg-poster', type:'error', message}.
